data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (venue search and suggestion, event click, optional date, optional filter, sort and times, Update Search, Book Now) with the right parameters. It adds an accessibility-specific filter detail that is narrower than the generic amenity filter and slightly vague on conditional steps, but a browser automation could still be built from it.
